title: keeps/NNNN/keep.json: one KEEP's snapshot, in component mode
description: Each KEEP writes keeps/NNNN/ (keep.json, change.patch, served.patch, config.json, tables/), then keeps/LATEST. A host imports the chain from root through parent to commit.

previous.description: the snapshot before it, null for the first

root.description: the commit the host gave the worktree

parent.description: the previous KEEP's commit, or the root

commit.description: the commit this KEEP's tree is

carries.description: earlier changes in the tree that no gate judged on their own

tables.description: {VAR: {path, file, sha256, bytes}}: the tables its env points at

retracts.description: a retraction's snapshot: the KEEP it takes back

outside.description: links the served tree makes outside itself

left_out.description: files over the size limit, left out of both patches

notes.description: what the snapshot could not do as asked
